question: Can genuine uniform next-token continued training improve held-out natural loss over unchanged B0 under a small, fixed development search?
model: Original Qwen3-1.7B-Base, fresh B0 initialization for every recipe.
objective: One clean original 528-token window; ordinary cross-entropy on all 527 shifted positions, each coefficient 1/(256*527). No auxiliary branch, synthetic text or continuation weighting.

training.optimizer: AdamW with existing ZeRO reduction once after accumulation
training.head_cross_entropy: fp32 logits and reduction after native head matmul

selection.criterion: Lowest DEV mean per-document full527 NLL after all four terminal checkpoints are fixed. Exact ties prefer lower peak LR, then lexical recipe name.
selection.checkpoints: Terminal128 only; no DEV checkpoint or prompt selection.
selection.confirmation: Freeze the chosen recipe and already-trained terminal checkpoint identity before any CONFIRM model outcome. Evaluate only it and B0 on CONFIRM.
selection.limits: Four settings, one common training order. Confirmation is conditional on the selected checkpoint, not independent training/model replication.

endpoints.primary: Chosen checkpoint minus unchanged B0 in mean full527-token NLL on 4096 untouched CONFIRM source documents; a positive lower95 bound on B0-minus-trained establishes baseline improvement.
secondary: Original final16-token likelihood on the same natural windows.
Full16 likelihood on the existing 1024 calculation sources, excluded from all new fitting; previously inspected diagnostic, not fresh confirmation.

statistics.interval: paired percentile95, confirmation only after recipe freeze; development rows disclosed for all four settings

requirements: Actual native initial uniform loss versus CPU reference.
One reducer, finite accumulated gradients, FP32 master updates, model replicas.
Actual base-optimizer LR matches planned optimizer-step LR across warmup and decay.
Full-state restore at update2 reproduces updates3/4 and terminal weights.
Measured workload and storage fit the declared scientific ceiling before fitting.

resources.preparation: 4 CPU cores, 30 minutes per source stage, 256 MiB data, zero model calls.
resources.status: Proposed ceilings, not measured runtime or a scientific execution release.
resources.storage: Existing /dev/shm full checkpoints, bounded180 GiB. Copy all four BF16 terminal models to existing nvme-cpt, bounded16 GiB, while preserving35 GiB disk and512 GiB host-available floors. No protected-state deletion.

interpretation: A competent uniform-NTP reference is required before another thought-augmented pretraining claim. A negative run does not uniquely identify LR, batch size or corpus causes; all completed trials remain reportable.
